No. `SELECT *` is bad in production.

**Why:**
- Unknown schema changes break your app
- Transfers unnecessary data
- Harder to track what columns you're using
- Can cause performance issues (larger result sets, more memory)
- Makes caching harder
- Obscures query intent

**Do this instead:**
```sql
SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE active = true
```

Explicit columns give you control, clarity, and performance.
